You have mods selected, but the game is being launched through Steam.

G3M applies mods to the game files in this configured path:

warnings.skip_all_tooltip: Dangerous: G3M will continue without asking even when the patch, merge, game path, or tool output looks unsafe. This can hide damaged files.

g3mtool_unavailable.title: G3MTool cannot be started
g3mtool_unavailable.body: G3M could not start G3MTool. Check the configured G3MTool path, restore the bundled tool, or choose a valid custom executable.

xdelta_apply_failed.title: XDELTA patch failed
xdelta_apply_failed.body: The XDELTA patch did not apply. This usually means the game version or DATA file does not match what the mod author used. Verify game files or use the required version.

g3mpatch_apply_failed.title: G3MPatch apply failed
g3mpatch_apply_failed.body: The patch could not be applied cleanly. Check that the patch matches the selected game and try again with a clean game folder.

merge_failed.title: Merge failed
merge_failed.body: G3MTool could not merge the selected mods. Check the report/logs and try fewer mods to find the conflict.

patched_output_missing.title: Patched output was not created
patched_output_missing.body: The tool finished without creating the expected output file. This may be caused by permissions, antivirus software, or a tool crash.

data_file_missing.title: Game DATA file was not found
data_file_missing.body: G3M could not find a game DATA file in the selected folder. Check the game path or install/restore the game files.

g3mpatch_original_hash_mismatch.title: Patch was created for another original file
g3mpatch_original_hash_mismatch.body: This patch was created for a different original file. It may still work, but the result can be wrong if the game version is different.

g3mpatch_newer_tool.title: Patch was created by a newer G3MTool
g3mpatch_newer_tool.body: This patch was created by a newer G3MTool version. Update G3M or choose a newer custom G3MTool executable if the result looks wrong.

merge_conflicts_detected.title: Merge conflicts were detected
merge_conflicts_detected.body: Multiple mods changed the same resources. Review the conflict report; continuing may pick one change over another.

steam_launch_with_mods.title: Steam may launch a different game folder
steam_launch_with_mods.body: Steam may launch a different game folder than the one G3M patched. Make sure the configured path matches Steam or launch directly.

custom_binary_invalid.title: Custom executable is invalid
custom_binary_invalid.body: The selected file could not be started as an executable. Choose the correct binary for this operating system.

minor_file_overrides_only.title: Only loose files will be copied
minor_file_overrides_only.body: No DATA file was found, so G3M will only copy loose files. This is fine for file-only mods.

cache_rebuild_needed.title: G3MTool cache will be rebuilt
cache_rebuild_needed.body: G3MTool will rebuild cache data for this file. The first run can be slower; later runs should be faster.

legacy_patching_warning.title: Other patching warning
legacy_patching_warning.body: G3M detected a patching or merging risk. Read the details before continuing.

extra_file_missing.title: Extra file is missing
extra_file_missing.body: An extra file referenced by the mod is missing: {path}. The mod may still run, but that file will not be installed. Reinstall or reimport the mod if this was not intentional.

extra_directory_missing.title: Extra folder is missing
extra_directory_missing.body: An extra folder referenced by the mod is missing: {path}. Files from that folder will not be installed. Reinstall or reimport the mod if this was not intentional.

extra_file_copy_failed.title: Extra file could not be copied
extra_file_copy_failed.body: G3M could not copy an extra file into the game folder. Check permissions, antivirus blocks, and free disk space.

extra_archive_extract_failed.title: Extra archive could not be extracted
extra_archive_extract_failed.body: An archive from the mod extra files could not be extracted. Some loose files from the mod may be missing in-game.

extra_xdelta_no_target.title: Extra XDELTA target was not found
extra_xdelta_no_target.body: An extra-file XDELTA patch did not find a matching target file. This is often harmless when the mod supports multiple game layouts, but that extra patch will be skipped.

extra_xdelta_apply_failed.title: Extra XDELTA patch failed
extra_xdelta_apply_failed.body: An XDELTA patch from the mod extra files could not be applied to its target. The main DATA patch may still work, but this extra file change will be skipped.

tooltips.g3mtool_unavailable: Shown when G3M cannot start the configured or bundled G3MTool executable.
tooltips.xdelta_apply_failed: Shown when a main .xdelta or .vcdiff patch cannot be applied to the selected DATA file.
tooltips.g3mpatch_apply_failed: Shown when a .g3mpatch cannot be applied cleanly to the selected DATA file.
tooltips.merge_failed: Shown when G3MTool cannot merge the selected mods or patches.
tooltips.patched_output_missing: Shown when a tool command finishes but the expected output file is missing.
tooltips.data_file_missing: Shown when G3M cannot find the DATA file that should be patched for the selected game or chapter.
tooltips.g3mpatch_original_hash_mismatch: Shown when a patch was created for a different original DATA file than the one currently selected.
tooltips.g3mpatch_newer_tool: Shown when the patch was created by a newer G3MTool than the one currently used.
tooltips.merge_conflicts_detected: Shown when the merge report contains resource conflicts.
tooltips.steam_launch_with_mods: Shown when Steam launch may open a different game folder than the one G3M patched.
tooltips.custom_binary_invalid: Shown when a configured custom executable cannot be started by the operating system.
tooltips.extra_file_missing: Shown when a mod references an extra file that no longer exists in the mod folder.
tooltips.extra_directory_missing: Shown when a mod references an extra folder that no longer exists in the mod folder.
tooltips.extra_file_copy_failed: Shown when G3M cannot copy an extra file into the game folder.
tooltips.extra_archive_extract_failed: Shown when an archive listed as an extra file cannot be extracted into the game folder.
tooltips.extra_xdelta_no_target: Shown when an extra-file XDELTA patch cannot find a matching target file.
tooltips.extra_xdelta_apply_failed: Shown when an extra-file XDELTA patch finds a target but cannot apply to it.
tooltips.minor_file_overrides_only: Shown for file-only mods where no DATA patch is applied.
tooltips.cache_rebuild_needed: Shown when G3MTool needs to rebuild reusable cache data for an input file.
tooltips.legacy_patching_warning: Shown for older or uncategorized patching and merging risks.
